proposals: The Office of the Economic Adviser in DPIIT should publish a domestic-output Producer Price Index alongside the WPI, so India has a producer-side series built like the ones most peers use and comparisons with the US, euro area, Japan or Korea do not have to be hedged as related but different instruments.

MoSPI should tag every WPI value served through its statistical API with its vintage and provisional or final status, and update it when the Office of the Economic Adviser revises, so April 2026 does not read 167.0 in one official source and 167.6 in the other.

The Office of the Economic Adviser should publish official calendar-year average WPI inflation rates, so international comparisons can use the same annual-average convention as other economies rather than an April-on-April anchor that does not match peers' series.
